title: Ukraine and Russia's asymmetric war of attrition
subhead: Kyiv and Moscow have stepped up attacks on each other's infrastructure in recent weeks, aiming to weaken the opposing economy and undermine morale. Ukraine has paid a heavier price because it does not possess ballistic missiles and finds it increasingly difficult to intercept those targeting its territory.
